text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
It's gotta be Narita Brian, right? But 
Hishi Amazon in the Shuka Sho was 
incredible too.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
No, no, Brian was incredible in the Kikuka 
Sho! She was like a total monster!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
There's a good chance a completely 
different girl might take the win. Man, I 
wonder how this Arima Kinen's gonna turn 
out!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's hearts were pounding with 
excitement for the fierce battle that was 
about to unfold.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: All riiiight!! I'm totally pumped up!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
There's no need for words! We've finally 
made it this far!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, at long last, the curtain rose on 
the Arima Kinen!
